package.description: AI script generation, text-to-speech, and text-based video editing

en-US.description: AI script generation, text-to-speech, and text-based video editing
en-US.longDescription:
Camtasia Audiate puts the power of AI in your hands to make video and audio editing easier than ever before.

Text-based video and audio editing
The easiest way to edit video and audio. If you can edit a document, you can edit a video.
- Easily transcribe your video voice over
- Edit your audio and video at the same time
- Changes to your voice over are automatically synced to your video
